text:
Ravi: Quick UX check on the vectors preview panel — QA caught two things: relevance badges overlap right-align actions at small widths, and the export label is vague. Screenshot: https://ci/internal/5001/shot.png

design-bot: build-5001 deployed for review

Nina: Re: badges  we should left-align them inside a fixed 64px column so they never collide with actions. Also increase contrast in dark theme (#D1D5DB text on rgba(255,255,255,0.06) bg).

Connor: Front-end: adding a fixed column is simple but watch responsive breakpoints. I'll collapse badges into an overflow menu under 520px.

Elena: Copy: change "Export vectors" -> "Download vectors (CSV)" and add secondary "Download NDJSON" in dropdown. Tooltip: "Includes id, embedding values, and metadata fields."

Nina: Accessibility: when preview opens SR focus should go to the title (not close button). Also include aria-live note when NDJSON export is ready: "Export complete: downloaded 3 items".

Ravi: +1 on focus and aria-live. Also add title attr on truncated metadata cells so users can see full key on hover.

Connor: I'll ship a small PR: fixed badge column, responsive collapse, updated CTA copy, and SR fixes. ETA tomorrow morning.
file_notes: design thread about layout, contrast, export formats, and a11y for embeddings rerank UI
